title: Reparar publicación faltante del candidate texto → audio
mission: Repair the missing isolated GitHub Pages publication for the existing generic text-to-audio candidate after Chromium CI proved the canonical candidate URL returns HTTP 404. Reconcile against durable source/evidence first: reuse the previously evidenced candidate blob f58801f1e67999923fac8eb36466b0ce33be2b8f when it remains the newest compatible preserved source, otherwise preserve a newer compatible source explicitly. Keep candidate-only authority and rerun the existing bounded Chromium smoke; do not create a new TTS backend or promote Current/Human Accepted/Served.
definition_of_done: The canonical candidate route https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/__canary/portfolio-tts-generic-text-surface-v1/ is backed again by a committed gh-pages source rather than HTTP 404.
Repair cites the exact source identity used; the historical evidenced blob f58801f1e67999923fac8eb36466b0ce33be2b8f may be restored only if no newer compatible preserved source supersedes it.
Candidate marker, six voices, maxlength/MAX 1800, existing audio-lab-page-audio-v1 backend reference and remote-generation disclosure remain preserve-first.
The existing tts-browser-smoke-ci-v1 run is rerun or retriggered and reaches the UI checks with zero generation POST; any remaining failure is recorded exactly.
No new TTS backend, scheduler, queue, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority is introduced.
non_goals: No ejecutar una generación de audio para reparar publicación.
